process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed with 'apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied', so gh pr view/diff, git diff and git rev-parse could not run. The change shape came from the head commit message (11ce684) plus Read/Grep of src/core/fix-round.test.ts:162. The exact diff, PR body/threads and closing issues were not read, and the second head-freshness check could not run.

Gating: going by the commit message, the change is one test-timeout constant (describe-level timeout 90_000 in src/core/fix-round.test.ts). Only review-conventions was spawned. correctness, security, maintainability, context, docs and spec were skipped: no real logic, trust boundary, infra surface, new prose or spec source was found, though the unreadable diff left this unconfirmed.
